choice_providers.label: Divine Hunter Domain
choice_providers.description: Choose one domain available from the Hunter's deity. Domain powers use effective Cleric level equal to Hunter level - 2, and its domain spells are added to spells known as the Hunter advances.

fixed_options.name: Celestial Template
fixed_options.description: Required for a good Hunter or a Hunter serving a good deity; neutral Hunters of neutral deities may choose it.

fixed_options.name: Fiendish Template
fixed_options.description: Required for an evil Hunter or a Hunter serving an evil deity; neutral Hunters of neutral deities may choose it.

resources.name: Wild Shape
resources.description: Animal forms only. Uses per day follow Druid Wild Shape at full Hunter level; level 20 is treated as at will.

resources.name: Favored Terrains
resources.description: Choose a favored terrain at 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter; distribute the +2 increases among owned terrains.

entries.choice_handling_note: The shared companion selector is restricted by the authored feature to plant companions. Plant Focus choices remain on the Hunter focus tracker and the companion sheet records its independent focus.
The shared companion selector records the required vermin companion; Hunter Tactics continues to share teamwork feats with the otherwise mindless companion.
Casting tradition, martial tradition, and blended magic/combat talent budget use the shared Spheres pickers.
The shared martial-tradition picker supplies the Beastmaster's Adept combat progression; the companion is marked combat trained and may wear light armor.

This archetype requires Sphere Hunter. Beastmastery (handle animal), Animal Companion, and Animal Empathy are granted through the shared talent and companion systems; its Adept martial budget remains independent from Sphere Hunter magic talents.
Casting and martial traditions plus the blended magic/combat talent budget use the shared Spheres workflow.

choice_providers.label: Performance Package
choice_providers.description: Choose the instrumental or lyric package granted with the Performance sphere.

entries.choice_handling_note: Casting tradition and Mid-Caster magic-talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow.

resource_adjustments.name: Reanimated Influence
resource_adjustments.description: Begins at 3 and can reach 6. Spirit Surge decreases influence while effects that normally reduce influence increase it; reaching 0 causes the 24-hour deathlike coma.

entries.choice_handling_note: Mind and Soul drives traditional casting and every registered Medium class-feature module through one permanent archetype choice.

choice_providers.label: Gozreh's Domain
choice_providers.description: Choose Air, Animal, Plant, Water, or Weather. The first granted power uses Medium level and domain spells 1st–6th are added to the Medium spell list.

resources.name: Storyteller's Performance
resources.description: Rounds per day equal to Bardic Performance at Medium level. Available performances are inspire courage, inspire competence, inspire greatness, and inspire heroics at their listed levels.

entries.choice_handling_note: The Bardic Performance tracker supplies rounds per day. Only inspire courage, inspire competence, inspire greatness, and inspire heroics are granted at their Storyteller levels.
Aspect Host requires Champion Medium; altered spirit aspects use the existing Medium spirit and influence controls.

resources.name: Energy Font
resources.description: Daily channel-energy uses from the Hierophant intermediate spirit power equal 1 + casting ability modifier.

entries.choice_handling_note: Casting tradition and blended magic/combat talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow; all Medium ability DCs use the chosen casting ability.

resource_adjustments.description: The Cult Master retains the 10th-level major Touch Treatment; the 3rd-, 6th-, and 14th-level treatments are exchanged by the archetype.

entries.choice_handling_note: Casting tradition and Low-Caster magic talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow.

resources.name: Spirit Communion
resources.description: Three daily uses; record the allies currently sharing the selected spirit ability.

resource_adjustments.name: Subject of the Stars
resource_adjustments.description: Spend 5 minutes to implant any number of available trick uses into a willing subject. Multiple copies of one trick and additional subjects unlock at the authored levels.

entries.choice_handling_note: Recurring trick selections use the shared Mesmerist Trick catalog; this archetype changes implantation, not the selected-trick progression.

resources.name: Horrid Mask
resources.description: Daily Horrid Mask uses equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

fixed_options.name: Selected Martial Weapon
fixed_options.description: Record the chosen martial weapon in the class-choice notes and proficiency editor.

entries.choice_handling_note: Casting and martial traditions plus the Mid blended magic/combat talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow.
Casting tradition and Mid-Caster magic-talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow.

Bluster is granted at 2nd level. Each later Mesmerist Trick slot may remain a trick or be exchanged for a Bluster or Communication talent; the recurring trick picker and skill-talent budget retain the authored choice rather than granting both automatically.

resources.name: Active Shrouds
resources.description: Maximum simultaneous shrouds equal 1 + half Mesmerist level. Record currently shrouded creatures; ending a shroud powers later Nocturnus abilities.

entries.choice_handling_note: Casting tradition and Mid-Caster magic talent progression use the shared Spheres workflow.
